en.headline: Police arrest 22 after dismantling cross-border money laundering syndicate
en.dek: The two-day Thundernet operation seized more than 1,600 bank cards, HK$5.85 million in cash and over 200 phones linked to more than HK$150 million laundered.
body: Police said they arrested 22 people after a two-day operation codenamed Thundernet that targeted a cross-border money-laundering syndicate active since August.

The New Territories North Regional Crime Unit searched a guesthouse, a subdivided unit and a shopfront operating as a virtual-currency over-the-counter exchange on Monday and Tuesday, police said. Those arrested include two local men and 20 mainland residents holding double-entry permits, aged 21 to 54. They are suspected of money laundering and conspiracy to launder money.

Investigators believe the group recruited mainland visitors to open bank accounts in Hong Kong using phones supplied by the syndicate, then directed them to withdraw cash from ATMs at different banks and locations. The cash was taken to the exchange shop, where organisers processed proceeds through virtual-currency transactions, police said.

The syndicate is estimated to have laundered more than HK$150 million between August and October, linked to more than 200 local fraud cases. Police seized more than 1,600 bank cards, about HK$5.85 million in cash and more than 200 mobile phones. Police reminded the public that money laundering is a serious offence and that people should not open or lend bank accounts for others to use.

zh.headline: 警方「雷網」行動搗破跨境洗黑錢集團 拘捕22人
zh.dek: 兩日行動檢獲逾1600張銀行提款卡、約585萬元現金及逾200部手機，集團8至10月疑清洗逾1.5億元。
body: 警方表示，新界北總區刑事部一連兩日展開代號「雷網」行動，成功瓦解一個自今年8月起活躍的跨境洗黑錢集團，拘捕22人。
警方搜查一間賓館、一個劏房單位及一個以虛擬貨幣場外交易所作為掩飾的店舖。被捕的22人包括2名本地男子及20名持雙程證來港的內地人士，年齡介乎21至54歲，涉嫌洗黑錢及串謀洗黑錢。
調查顯示，集團涉嫌招攬內地人士來港，利用集團提供的手提電話開設傀儡銀行戶口接收款項，再指示他們到不同銀行及地點的櫃員機提取現金，然後將現金運往該店舖，由主腦透過買賣虛擬貨幣等手法處理犯罪得益。
警方相信，集團在8月至10月期間已清洗逾1.5億元，涉及超過200宗本地騙案。行動中檢獲超過1600張銀行提款卡、約585萬元現金及超過200部手提電話。警方重申，洗黑錢屬嚴重罪行，市民切勿開設或借出銀行戶口供他人使用。
